name: Text input
description: A text field form control for the user to type text in to. For simply displaying text, use the 'Text' object instead.

conditions.description: Compare the text currently entered in to the text input.

text.name: Text
text.desc: The text to compare the text input's text to.

case.name: Case
case.desc: Choose whether the comparison is case sensitive (FOO different to Foo) or case insensitive (FOO same as Foo).

conditions.description: Triggered when the text in the text input changes.
Triggered when the text input is clicked.
Triggered when the text input is double-clicked.

text.desc: The text to set in the text input.

actions.description: Add text to the end of the existing text.

text.name: Text
text.desc: Enter the text to append to the object's content.

tooltip.name: Tooltip
tooltip.desc: The tooltip to set on the text input.

mode.name: Mode
mode.desc: Choose whether to enable or disable read-only mode.

actions.description: Scroll to the bottom of the text input if a textarea.

max-length.name: Max length
max-length.desc: The maximum number of characters that can be entered. Use -1 for unlimited.

expressions.description: Get the text input's current text.
Get the maximum number of characters that can be entered, or -1 for unlimited.

text.name: Text
text.desc: The initial text for the text input.

placeholder.name: Placeholder
placeholder.desc: A tip to display when the text input is empty.

tooltip.name: Tooltip

initially-visible.name: Initially visible
initially-visible.desc: Choose if the object is visible when the layout starts.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.desc: Whether the control is enabled or disabled on startup.

read-only.name: Read-only
read-only.desc: Whether the text input is read-only on startup.

spell-check.name: Spell check
spell-check.desc: Allow the browser to spell-check the text input, if supported.

type.name: Type
type.desc: The kind of text entered in to the text input, which also affects on-screen keyboards on touch devices.

auto-font-size.name: Auto font size
auto-font-size.desc: Automatically set the font size depending on the layer scale.

id.name: ID
id.desc: An optional ID for the element allowing it to be styled with CSS.

class.name: Class
class.desc: An optional class for the element allowing it to be styled with CSS.
